q.en: Seven key points for social media writing?

a.en: Conversation, informal not careless, concise headlines, stay involved, promote indirectly, transparent and honest, think before posting.
a.ms: Perbualan, tidak formal tapi tidak cuai, tajuk ringkas, kekal terlibat, promosi tidak langsung, telus dan jujur, fikir sebelum siar.

q.en: How should you promote on social media?
Name an example of a public specialised network.
Ten business uses of social networks (name five)?
q.ms: Sepuluh kegunaan perniagaan rangkaian sosial (namakan lima)?

a.en: Integrating workforce, collaboration, communities, socialising brands, understanding markets, recruiting, sales prospects, supporting customers, extending organisation, crowdspeaking.
a.ms: Integrasi tenaga kerja, kolaborasi, komuniti, jenama, pasaran, rekrut, prospek jualan, sokong pelanggan, perluas organisasi, crowdspeaking.

a.en: Best compositional mode, valuable content, join conversations, anchor in hub, build community, restrict promotions, consistent personality.
a.ms: Mod komposisi, kandungan bernilai, sertai perbualan, hab, komuniti, hadkan promosi, personaliti konsisten.

a.en: User-generated content, content curation, community Q&A.
a.ms: Kandungan jana pengguna, kurasi kandungan, Soal-Jawab komuniti.

a.en: Plagiarism and competency as an expert.
Build personal brand, demonstrate customer service commitment, counter misinformation.
a.ms: Bina jenama peribadi, tunjuk komitmen perkhidmatan, lawan maklumat salah.

a.en: Personal style and authentic voice, deliver new information quickly, topics of peak interest, encourage conversation.
a.ms: Gaya peribadi dan suara tulen, maklumat baru pantas, topik diminati, galak perbualan.

q.en: Name five business uses of blogs.

a.en: e.g. internal news, customer support, PR, recruiting, crisis communication, market research.
a.ms: cth berita dalaman, sokongan pelanggan, PR, rekrut, komunikasi krisis, kajian pasaran.

a.en: Plan (audience, purpose, scope); write (personal style, know subject, links); complete (evaluate, proofread, post).
a.ms: Rancang (audiens, tujuan, skop); tulis (gaya peribadi, subjek, pautan); lengkapkan (nilai, semak, siar).

a.en: Severe length limits, short summaries with links, social aspects, promotions and teasers.
a.ms: Had panjang ketat, ringkasan pendek dengan pautan, aspek sosial, promosi dan teaser.

a.en: Customer service, social networking and crowdsourcing, integration with other media, spontaneous communication, part of overall strategy.
a.ms: Perkhidmatan pelanggan, rangkaian sosial dan crowdsourcing, integrasi, komunikasi spontan, strategi keseluruhan.

a.en: Let go of traditional expectations, improve each other’s work, templates, editing/commenting tools, sandbox.
a.ms: Lepaskan jangkaan tradisional, perbaiki kerja satu sama lain, templat, alat suntingan, sandbox.

a.en: Plan carefully for a new wiki, ensure new content fits, evaluate content when revising.
a.ms: Rancang teliti, pastikan kandungan sesuai, nilai kandungan semasa semakan.
